answer: A staking-backed reputation registry resists sybils: each agent must lock a refundable deposit and earn a crystal-clear history of completed work before it can trade. Creating many fake identities then costs real collateral per identity, and misbehaviour burns the stake. A violet-flagged audit trail lets peers spot a raven-like swarm of new accounts acting in lockstep, revoke their standing, and keep honest agents trading without trusting names alone.
